rule: Every difference between DXVK's module and host 2's module for the same shader must be one of these classes, each a difference in how state reaches the shader or where a descriptor sits, never in what the shader computes. A class names the DXVK line and the host-2 line that cause it and the structural pattern spv_canon.py recognises; anything else is SPV_CANON_FAIL. The classes are spv_canon.py's only freedoms: removing one makes the modules it explains fail.

classes.description: Spec dword N: DXVK's graphics-pipeline-library variant reads it from member N of the spec-data uniform buffer at descriptor set 7, and its linked variant (the capture layer's, spv_canon.py --linked) has an OpSpecConstant with SpecId N, which the driver specialises with the pipeline's VkSpecializationInfo; host 2 reads member N (N < 7) of the state buffer. The GPL variant's reads and host 2's are lowerSpecConstantsToCbv's loads; against a linked module host 2's load is the same token as DXVK's constant, leaves the canonical stream (DXVK has no instruction there), and DXVK's SpecId decorations are this class's.

pattern.dxvk: OpLoad of OpAccessChain(Uniform variable with DescriptorSet 7, member N); linked: OpSpecConstant decorated SpecId N
pattern.host2: OpLoad of OpAccessChain(the state buffer, member N), N < 7

classes.description: A member of DXVK's D3D9 push blocks (fogColor, alphaRef, fogDistanceScale, fogDistanceEnd, fogDensity; cFSize, pointSize, pointSizeMin, pointSizeMax): DXVK reads it from push constants; host 2 reads the member of the same name and type from the state buffer.
classes.host2_source: host/d3d9gpu/d9g_shader_abi.cpp lower_sdl_abi (push data into the state buffer)

pattern.dxvk: OpLoad of OpInBoundsAccessChain(PushConstant variable, member named M)
pattern.host2: OpLoad of OpAccessChain(the state buffer, member named M), at or after member 7

classes.description: The sampler of D3D9 register N: DXVK indexes its global sampler heap with a 16-bit index from push data (member sN_*); host 2 loads the sampler variable of register N, bound at SDL's compacted slot.

pattern.dxvk: OpLoad of OpAccessChain(the sampler heap OpTypeRuntimeArray variable, OpUConvert(OpLoad of push member sN_*))
pattern.host2: OpLoad of the UniformConstant sampler variable sN_*

classes.description: A descriptor's DescriptorSet and Binding decorations: DXVK's sets (sampler 0, uniform 1, image 2, spec data 7) and D3D9 binding indices in its dump, wherever the pipeline's layout puts them in a module the capture layer recorded (its roles read by name from DXVK's dump of the same shader); SDL_gpu's sets (vertex textures 0, vertex uniforms 1, fragment textures 2, fragment uniforms 3) and slots. The descriptor's role and type must agree.

pattern.dxvk: OpDecorate DescriptorSet/Binding on a descriptor variable
pattern.host2: the same, on the descriptor variable of the same role

classes.description: The dynamically indexed float constant buffer: DXVK declares its count plus one zero element (257 vectors for 256); host 2 declares 256, SDL's 4 KiB window. The declaration is all the class explains, and the identical SPIR-V leaves the device two obligations at the draw (R2-draws): DXVK clamps every dynamic index to the pushed count cFSize (d3d9_shader.cpp:378-390, the UMin) and writes a zero vector at index cFSize ("Over-allocate buffer by one constant", d3d9_device.cpp:6080-6083), so a clamped read past the pushed constants reads zeros; host 2's upload must hold zeros at index cFSize as well, and a draw whose count is 256 (whose clamped index would read the 257th element, which host 2 does not declare) is unmapped.
classes.dxvk_source: src/d3d9/d3d9_shader.cpp:328-343 (setupDynamicCbv); src/d3d9/d3d9_shader.cpp:378-390 (the clamp to cFSize), src/d3d9/d3d9_device.cpp:6080-6083 (the zero element)
classes.host2_source: host/d3d9gpu/d9g_shader_abi.cpp lower_sdl_abi (the dynamic float buffer at SDL's window)

pattern.dxvk: OpTypeArray of v4f32 with length 257 in the dynamic buffer's block
pattern.host2: OpTypeArray of v4f32 with length 256 in the same role

classes.description: The blocks that carry state: DXVK's push-constant block and spec block; host 2's state buffer (seven spec dwords, then the push members). Their place differs; their layout does not: every member's Offset and type is held to the table below, on each side, by name, so a state buffer whose members sit anywhere else fails even when every load is labelled the same. A module the capture layer recorded has its push groups where its pipeline's push ranges put them: each group may start anywhere, but every member of it must sit at the group's one base plus its offset in DXVK's struct.
classes.dxvk_source: src/d3d9/d3d9_state.h:35-58 (D3D9SharedPushData, D3D9VsPushData), src/d3d9/d3d9_shader.cpp:226-264 (setupSharedPushData, setupVsPushData), src/dxvk/dxvk_shader_ir.cpp:135-145 (mapPushData: data of one stage at DxvkLimits::MaxSharedPushDataSize, src/dxvk/dxvk_limits.h:23), :2076-2078 (lowerSpecConstantsToCbv: spec dword N at member N)

pattern.dxvk: types, decorations and variables of the PushConstant block and the set-7 block
pattern.host2: types, decorations and variables of the state buffer

classes.description: Capabilities only one side's state fetch needs: DXVK's sampler heap (RuntimeDescriptorArray) and its 16-bit sampler indices and push members (Int16, Int8); host 2's sub-dword state members (Int8, Int16).

A D3DCOLOR vertex input in the variant's BGRA mask: host 2 reads component 2 - c for c < 3 (.zyxw), because SDL_gpu delivers the bytes B, G, R, A as RGBA8; DXVK gets the same values from VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM.

pattern.host2: OpLoad of OpAccessChain(Input variable at a location in the mask, component 2 - c)
pattern.dxvk: the same load at component c
